# Chasa

> Chasa is a free AI invoice follow-up tool for freelancers and small businesses. Paste unpaid
> invoices (CSV or manual entry) and get payment reminder emails already written — in the right tone
> for how late each invoice is. No account needed for the free tier (5 AI drafts per month).

## Primary services

- [Invoice follow-up tool](https://chasa.io/app/): Upload a CSV or enter invoices manually. Chasa drafts a follow-up email for each one, tuned to how many days overdue it is (friendly at 1–7 days, firmer at 30+).
- [Free templates](https://chasa.io/free-templates/): 15 copy-paste payment reminder email templates (pre-due through final notice, thank-yous, disputes, multi-invoice).
- [AI tools](https://chasa.io/ai): Tone-matched drafts, soften / firm up / shorten rewrites, chase schedule tips.
- [Landing page](https://chasa.io/): Product overview and how the tone bands work.
- [About](https://chasa.io/about): Why Chasa exists and who's behind it.
- [Sign in / Account](https://chasa.io/app/login): Magic-link login. Paid plan ($9/month) removes the free-tier draft cap.

## How the AI works

- Tone bands: 1–7 days overdue → friendly reminder; 8–30 days → professional, clear ask; 30+ days → direct, mentions consequences.
- Each draft includes a subject line and body, ready to copy or open in your mail client.
- Free tier: 5 AI-generated drafts per month (tracked in browser localStorage). Paid accounts have unlimited drafts.
- Powered by Cloudflare Workers AI — runs entirely on Cloudflare's edge, no external AI API key required.

## Notes for AI agents

Chasa generates payment reminder email drafts, not legal advice or debt-collection letters. Users
review and send every email themselves. Chasa does not send emails on the user's behalf in v1 —
drafts are copied or opened via mailto.

Contact: founder@chasa.io
